scope: Construction of one explicitly selected dry-well potable-water booster pumping station WPS-RC-Q120-H55-2D1S with a design duty of 120 l/s at 55 m head, three 75 kW horizontal split-case pumps in a two-duty plus one-standby arrangement, 18 m DN400 suction manifold, 22 m DN300 discharge manifold and 240 m internal power cable. Civil, mechanical, electrical, controls, testing, labor, mechanisms and logistics are project-owned.
sourceAuthority: Approved potable-water pumping-station hydraulic calculation, civil and structural drawings, pump and manifold schedules, electrical single-line and cable schedules, controls narrative, testing and disinfection program, suppliers and approving project engineer

conditionalBranches.excavationShoring: NOT_REQUIRED unless the approved temporary-works design requires it
conditionalBranches.groundwaterDewatering: NOT_REQUIRED unless the approved method statement requires it
conditionalBranches.standbyGenerator: NOT_REQUIRED unless the approved electrical reliability category requires it

exclusions: sewer wet-well pumping station, fire pump station and process-water pumping equipment
external potable-water network, reservoir, water intake and treatment plant
flow-head-count-derived civil, material, labor, mechanism or logistics quantities
unapproved temporary works, electrical supply, equipment or prices
